title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
description: A rich and velvety Continental soup made with fresh mushrooms, aromatics, cream, and stock, finished with elegant garnishes for a classic restaurant-style presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Soup Base
items: Assorted fresh mushrooms (button, cremini, shiitake) – 300 g, finely sliced
Fresh thyme – 1 sprig (or ¼ tsp dried thyme)
Vegetable or chicken stock – 500 ml (2 cups)
Salt and freshly ground white pepper – to taste

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: A drizzle of cream or truffle oil

instruction.title: Step 1 – Sauté the Aromatics
steps: In a heavy-bottomed saucepan, heat butter and olive oil over medium heat.
Add onions and garlic; cook until soft and translucent.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Cook the Mushrooms
steps: Sauté for 8–10 minutes until mushrooms release their moisture and begin to caramelize.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Build the Base
steps: Sprinkle in the flour and cook for 1 minute to remove the raw taste.
Gradually add warm stock, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Simmer & Blend
steps: Remove the thyme sprig and blend the soup until smooth (use a hand blender or countertop blender).

instruction.title: Step 5 – Finish with Cream
steps: Return to the pot and stir in the cream.
Season with salt and white pepper.
Simmer gently for 2–3 minutes — do not boil.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Presentation
steps: Drizzle with cream or truffle oil.
Garnish with sautéed mushroom slices and thyme sprigs.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with crusty bread or garlic toast.
Pair with a light green salad for a complete meal.

chefTips: For deeper flavor, mix wild mushrooms (porcini, morels) with button mushrooms.
Add a splash of dry white wine before adding stock for a gourmet touch.
For a vegan variation, use plant-based cream and vegetable stock.
